meta.title: Privacy Policy — Sicily Driver Syracuse
meta.description: Personal data processing notice under EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR). Sicily Driver Syracuse is the data controller.

Privacy.intro: This page describes how the site ncctaxisiracusa.com handles personal data of the users who consult it. The notice is provided pursuant to Art. 13 of EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Italian Legislative Decree 196/2003 as amended.

s1.p: The data controller is Sicily Driver Siracusa (Loris Lo Russo, VAT 02150600894), with operating office in Syracuse, Italy. Email: info@ncctaxisiracusa.com — Phone: +39 375 641 3379.

s2.p: We process data you voluntarily provide by filling in the contact, tour booking or wedding quote forms: first name, last name, email address, phone number, service date, number of passengers and any additional notes. We also process navigation data automatically collected by IT systems (IP addresses, browser type, operating system, URL references, timestamps) for the sole purpose of the site's functioning and aggregated anonymous statistics.

s3.p: Data is processed to: (a) reply to quote or information requests; (b) manage booking and execution of the NCC service; (c) comply with legal obligations (invoicing, accounting); (d) improve the site through anonymous aggregated analytics, only with your explicit consent via the cookie banner.

s4.p: Processing is based on: (a) performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures at your request (Art. 6.1.b GDPR) — for booking and replies; (b) explicit consent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR) — for analytics and marketing cookies; (c) legal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR) — for invoicing and tax compliance; (d) legitimate interest (Art. 6.1.f GDPR) — for technical site functioning.

s5.p: The site uses technical cookies necessary for functioning, and optional cookies (analytics and marketing) activated only with your explicit consent via the banner that appears on first visit. You can change your preferences at any time from the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of every page. Technical cookies include: session cookie, language preference, storage of the consent itself.

s6.p: Data is not disclosed or sold to third parties. It may be communicated only to subjects involved in service delivery (e.g. partners for joint tours — Pura Vida Beach Club, Cantina Benanti, Fratelli Burgio, Palmeri — only as strictly necessary to execute the requested service) and to technical providers (Vercel hosting, email). Data is retained for the time necessary to the purposes (10 years for tax obligations, 24 months from end of relationship for communications).

s7.p: Under Articles 15–22 GDPR you have the right to: access your data, request its correction or deletion, restrict processing, object to processing, receive data in a structured format (portability), withdraw consent at any time. To exercise your rights write to info@ncctaxisiracusa.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).

s8.p: We may update this notice to reflect regulatory or operational changes. The date of the last update is shown at the top of the page. We invite you to consult it periodically.

We don't just

Sicily isn't crossed,
it's lived.

esperienze.card1Body: Explore Ortigia aboard a vintage Fiat 500 Spiaggina. A route through historic alleys, sea views and the city's most iconic spots, with photo stops and an aperitif at sunset.
esperienze.card2Body: Between the Plemmirio Nature Reserve, hidden bays and the crystal-clear waters of the Syracuse coast, you'll discover a Sicily you can't see from land. Swim stops, an on-board aperitif with Sicilian produce and Prosecco, while the wind carries you along one of the most beautiful coasts in Sicily.
esperienze.card3Tag: South coast · full day · Pura Vida Beach Club
esperienze.card3Body: The south-eastern tip of the island, where the Ionian meets the Mediterranean. Lunch at Pura Vida, sunset on the sea, aperitivo in Marzamemi before the return.
esperienze.card4Tag: Etna · full day · quad and wineries
esperienze.card4Body: Craters, vineyards and extraordinary views. From an excursion on Europe's highest active volcano to a winery tasting with a light lunch and Etna wines. A complete experience among the nature, tradition and authentic flavours of Sicily.
esperienze.card5Body: Noto, Modica and Ragusa Ibla, three UNESCO World Heritage cities where Sicilian Baroque reaches its highest expression. Monumental churches, noble palaces, timeless views and the famous chocolate of Modica, on a journey into the heart of Sicily.
esperienze.customTagline: These are just a few ideas. Your Sicilian experience can be so much more.

manifesto.h2: We don't just do transfers. We create experiences.
manifesto.lead: Private transfers, exclusive tours and tailor-made events across Syracuse, Ortigia, Noto, Modica, Ragusa Ibla, Taormina, Catania and all of Sicily.
manifesto.row1Body: From Catania, Comiso, Palermo and Trapani airports to Syracuse, Ortigia, Noto, Ragusa, Modica, Taormina and any destination in Sicily. Travel aboard our premium Mercedes with professional drivers and dedicated assistance.
manifesto.row2Body: Discover Ortigia, Noto, Modica, Ragusa Ibla, Marzamemi, Taormina, Etna and the most authentic places in Sicily. Private itineraries built around your interests, to experience the island exclusively and without rushing.
manifesto.row3Body: Dedicated transport for weddings, corporate events and special occasions across Sicily. Guest coordination, a premium fleet, professional drivers and full logistics management.
manifesto.body1: Sicily Driver Syracuse is your partner for chauffeur-driven car services (NCC) across the whole of Sicily. We offer private transfers to and from all the island’s airports — Catania, Comiso, Palermo and Trapani — as well as connections to the ports of Pozzallo and Augusta. Travel in maximum comfort aboard our luxury vans — including Mercedes V-Class, GLB Premium and E-Class — 24 hours a day.
manifesto.body2: Our bespoke tours reach the Baroque of Noto, Modica and Ragusa Ibla, the lunar landscapes of Etna, ancient Ortigia and the terraces of Taormina. The dedicated service is designed for weddings, corporate events and tailor-made travel.

partnersBar.intro: The excellence that shapes our journey.

faq.h2: The ones we get asked most.
faq.q1: How much does an airport transfer from Catania cost?
faq.a1: Prices start at €80 per trip for our chauffeur-driven (NCC) service with luxury vans, varying based on route and number of passengers.
faq.q2: Can I book a Baroque tour in one day?
faq.a2: Yes: we offer 4–8 hour tours with optional guide; the itinerary is customizable and includes Noto, Modica, Ragusa Ibla.
faq.q3: Do you offer late-night private taxi service?
faq.a3: Certainly: our NCC operates 24/7, perfect for evening transfers to restaurants, events, or airports.

interni.body: Our Mercedes V-Class, GLB Premium and E-Class are prepared with the same care we reserve for our clients. Cold water on board, sanitised after every service and Wi-Fi on request. Because comfort isn't only about the destination, but the whole journey.

dietro.h2: Sicily is our home. Sharing it is our work.
dietro.body1: Sicily Driver Syracuse was born from a love for this land and the desire to show it the right way. Every year we accompany travellers from all over the world across Syracuse, Ortigia, Noto, Marzamemi, Modica, Ragusa Ibla, Catania, Taormina, Palermo and Etna, offering private transfers, exclusive tours and tailor-made experiences.
dietro.body2: We speak fluent Italian and English and we know Sicily beyond the guidebooks. We know which places are worth a stop, which restaurants we'd recommend to our friends and which roads offer the most beautiful views.
dietro.body3: We wait for you if your flight is late, we adapt every itinerary to your needs and we're always available when you need us. Because a good driver takes you to your destination. A great driver makes you experience Sicily.
dietro.alt: Luxury van parked on a Val di Noto road at sunset

testimonianze.h2Accent: come from those who chose us

items.quote: We used Sicily Driver Syracuse this week for all of our travel needs and were blown away by Alberto's punctuality and hospitality. He always arrived earlier than he said he would for pickups, in a pristinely clean vehicle, and was extremely helpful. He was very patient when we were late getting back to the car one day and was also patient with our teething infant. Whether you are doing tours or simply need transfers, I would definitely recommend them for all of your needs.
items.author: Evan Long

items.quote: Excellent service and good price, very helpful and easy to communicate and arrange a driver. Highly recommend and would use them again. The van was very nice and new and clean and driver was kind and explain some facts about Sicily on the way.
items.author: Selina Mok

items.quote: Vincenzo was prompt, courteous, and professional. The vehicles are spotless, and he speaks impeccable English. We plan to be in Syracuse again and will definitely hire Sicily Driver Siracusa.
items.author: Jenni Wilson

items.quote: I use Vincenzo's services regularly and am very satisfied. He's very punctual, professional, and great company! The vehicle was very comfortable, clean, and had all the necessary options. Top-notch! I recommend him without hesitation!
items.author: Diane Paumier

items.quote: Oggi ho fatto un tranfer da Fontane Bianche ad Ortigia ed è andato tutto bene: macchina pulita, elegante e con tutti i comfort. L'autista mi ha fatto trovare anche una bottiglietta d'acqua a bordo.
items.author: Gaia Conforto

items.quote: We booked Vincenzo on a short notice to drive guests back from our wedding venue to their accommodations. He was very helpful and had great communication, I recommend his services!
items.author: Raphaël Bismut

items.quote: NCC di prima classe. Ho avuto bisogno di un trasfert per l'aeroporto e ho contattato questo NCC referenziato da un mio collega. Che dire: massima pulizia, cortesia e confort. Macchina super spaziosa. Li richiamerò sicuramente per i prossimi viaggi. CONSIGLIATISSIMO.
items.author: Alberto Scamacca

items.quote: We had a great experience with this driver — reliable, punctual, and very professional. We arranged the ride a day in advance, and he responded immediately. The car was in excellent condition, the price was fair, and he speaks good English, which made communication easy and pleasant. Highly recommended!
items.author: Marina Karaklic

items.quote: Vincenzo went out of his way to accommodate us. He went above and beyond and was reliable. He made us feel comfortable, and we wish he was our driver all the time. Excellent experience overall.
items.author: Nick C.

items.quote: Mia moglie ed io abbiamo fatto il Tour del Barocco visitando Noto, Modica e Ragusa. È stato bellissimo e l'autista è stato molto gentile! L'auto era pulitissima.
items.author: Giulia Magnano

items.quote: If you need a ride to and from the airport or a day tour, do yourself a favor and contact Vincenzo. He is punctual, his car is clean, he is a great driver, communicative on WhatsApp and will go out of his way to make you happy! He is reasonably priced and you'll be very comfortable in his Mercedes. He speaks English and is so personable that you'll be able to communicate no matter what language. You will be so happy you followed this advice!
items.author: Jenny Samaan

items.quote: Ho apprezzato molto il servizio. Vincenzo è un ottimo autista e sono rimasto colpito dalla pulizia dell'auto. Lo userò sicuramente di nuovo.
items.author: Giovanni Napolitano

items.quote: Vincenzo was amazing. Very attentive and informative. Planning on continuing to use Vincenzo throughout our trip for tours and for a ride back to the airport. Thank you again Vincenzo!
items.author: Jason Ostby

items.quote: Esperienza positiva: lo richiamerò. Mi ha lasciato il suo numero e mi servirà per tutto il soggiorno.
items.author: Emilio Di Maggio

items.quote: The driver was punctual and professional and our transfers to the hotel was super easy. Thank you Enzo!
items.author: Anne-Marie Napolitano

intro.body: At Sicily Driver Syracuse we offer four ways of being driven around eastern Sicily, with the same luxury-van fleet and the same chauffeurs throughout: point-to-point airport transfers, private day tours, wedding and event service, business solutions for companies and VIP guests.

cards.h2Pre: How do you want to experience
cards.card1Body: From the moment you land, everything is already taken care of. Your driver will be waiting right at arrivals with your name clearly displayed, will monitor your flight in real time and walk you to the vehicle, taking care of your luggage too. We arrange private transfers to and from the airports of Catania, Comiso, Palermo and Trapani and the ports of Pozzallo and Augusta, connecting Syracuse, Ortigia, Noto, Taormina, Modica, Ragusa Ibla and Sicily's main destinations.
cards.card2Body: Baroque, Etna, Ortigia + Taormina. Tours customised on request. 6–9 hours with bespoke stops.
cards.card3Body: A dedicated fleet for the big day. V-Class for guests, E-Class for the couple.
cards.card4Body: Corporate transfers, conferences, VIP guests. Standard and electronic invoicing.

faq.q1: How much advance notice do you need?
faq.a1: For airport transfers, a WhatsApp message even 2 hours before is fine. For tours and weddings we recommend 7–15 days in advance to secure the right fleet.
faq.q2: Do you cover all of Sicily or only the east?
faq.a2: We operate primarily in eastern Sicily (provinces of Syracuse, Catania, Ragusa, southern Messina). For central or western Sicily we organise with more notice.
faq.q3: Only point-to-point transfers or hourly hire as well?
faq.a3: Both: point-to-point transfers and hourly hire (half day, full day) with car and driver at your disposal.
faq.q4: Can we pay by bank transfer in advance?
faq.a4: Yes, this is the preferred method for weddings, events, business and tours booked in advance. Cash and card accepted on board for transfers.

meta.title: About · The story of Sicily Driver Syracuse | NCC Sicily
meta.description: The story of Sicily Driver Syracuse: quality NCC services across eastern Sicily. Three bases (Syracuse, Noto, Marzamemi), a curated luxury-van fleet, English-speaking drivers.

hero.subhead: Three bases, a luxury-van fleet looked after like family, drivers who speak real English — not Google Translate English.

story.body1: Sicily Driver Syracuse is a young and dynamic company born from a passion for high-quality NCC and transfer services. With extensive experience in crafting personalised journeys, we provide tailored solutions for individuals and businesses seeking comfort and safety in their travels.
story.body2: Thanks to our carefully selected fleet and attention to detail, we guarantee punctuality and courtesy on every trip. Our team consists of transportation professionals who understand the specific needs of our clients, ready to support you 24/7 throughout your journey.
story.body3: Choosing Sicily Driver Syracuse means trusting a dedicated partner: from airport transfers and NCC services for events to private excursions and tours. We are by your side to make every journey enjoyable and worry-free.

beliefs.item1Body: From Catania to Marzamemi, fare agreed before departure. No hidden surcharges, no mysterious 'night rate'.
beliefs.item2Body: V-Class, GLB Premium, E-Class. Weekly mechanical checks, sanitised after every service. Cold water on board, always.
beliefs.item3Body: Our chauffeurs speak fluent Italian and English. They know the roads, the mass times in Modica, and where to actually eat well in Ortigia.

faq.q1: How quickly do you reply on WhatsApp?
faq.a1: Within 1 hour during the day, by the next morning if you write in the middle of the night. For urgent flights and transfers, message us on WhatsApp: it's the fastest channel.
faq.q2: Can I also book for the same day?
faq.a2: Yes, if we're available. For a same-day airport transfer, message us on WhatsApp: it's the quickest way to get confirmation.
faq.q3: Do you require a deposit when booking?
faq.a3: For standard tours usually not: you pay at the end of the service, by card or cash. For weddings and large groups we ask for a 30% deposit confirmed by bank transfer.
faq.q4: What happens if I need to cancel?
faq.a4: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the service. From 24 to 4 hours before, a 30% charge. Less than 4 hours before, the full charge. For emergencies such as cancelled flights or unexpected events, we're always flexible.
